page_title: AI Coding Agent for Building Ambitious Software | Cursor

sources.entry: Cursor - A VS Code-inspired AI-powered code editor that provides real-time code suggestions, error detection, debugging assistance, and AI-generated explanations. Built for AI-first software development.

summary.name: Cursor
summary.one_liner: Cursor is an AI coding agent and code editor for building software, with agents that write, test and demo features and can run in the terminal, Slack and GitHub.
keywords: hand off coding tasks to ai
use_cases: Handing off coding tasks to autonomous agents
Running multiple coding agents in parallel
Reviewing pull requests in GitHub with AI
Getting coding help from a terminal CLI
Building and testing features end to end with AI agents
Team collaboration on code via Slack
summary.what_it_does: Cursor is presented as a coding agent for building software. Agents turn ideas into code, and tasks can be handed off while the user makes decisions. Agents run on their own computers to build, test and demo features end to end for review. Cursor runs in the terminal via a CLI, integrates with Slack, and reviews pull requests in GitHub. The page also says users can pick among models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI and Cursor, and launch fleets of agents that run in parallel for hours or days.
notable: Agents use their own computers to build, test and demo features end to end
Choice of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI and Cursor
Bots can sign in to tools and return finished work
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform support beyond the CLI, Slack and GitHub integrations is not detailed on the page
